posts.meta_description:
4,455 likes, 187 comments - debasreee on June 22, 2026: "Linked everything to reach your DMs 🔗 

Pick one to your budget! Remember skin tints don’t have a lot of coverage, so if you want something buildable or heavier let me know? 

I love moisturising my skin well before makeup, rmemever to keep it on for at least 2-3 minutes before doing your makeup and never skip sunscreen in the morning! I have combination skin and love wearing the bioderma one, but if you have dry skin then try the physiogel! And if you want moisture plus glow, then try the flicka one! 

Okay I’m sorry I didn’t include a budget friendly one, but this is one category you can splurge! 🙈

Or get a lip and cheek tint.  I love products that are multi-purpose, and save time! 

I have no alternatives, simply the best in brow business @benefitindia 

One for every budget, but tbh I wear the colossal one the most. I do love a waterproof formula, if you want to know makeup removers that actually remove them then ask away! 

Let me know which shade matches your fingers 👀

Innisfree one for my oily skin girlies 
Kay one for dry and combination skin 
Charlotte one is best for brightening up the undereye! I love this powder so much! 

Want Part 2? 👀".

70 likes, 7 comments - debasreee on October 9, 2026: "Nobody tells you that postpartum changes more than just your routine. It changes the way you see yourself too. 🥹

Looking back at an old photo made me realise just how much had changed, including my skin. That’s when I knew it was time to get serious about my skincare.

Enter Olay Ultra Firming Serum! ✨ With PHCA, Bakuchiol and Collagen Peptides, it helps my skin look smoother, firmer and more lifted.

Because while motherhood is a big part of who I am, taking care of myself deserves to be a priority too. 💛

Play Mode: OFF.
Serious Skincare: ON. ✨

#OlayIndia #SeriousSkincareOn #PostpartumJourney #MomLife #SkincareRoutine".

2,304 likes, 58 comments - debasreee on October 5, 2026: "Shobai eshechhilo!! 😍❤️

Thank you Kolkata, for one of the most memorable birthday celebrations. 🙏🏽 Tomra shobai eto shundor kore sheje eshechhile je, shei din-er vibe ta puro Durga Pujo’r moto lagchhilo! 🥹❤️

Tomader shobar shathe kotha bole khub bhalo legechhe. Thank you for sharing your stories with me, for taking the time to come, and for making the day so special.

Tomader shobar creator journey’r jonno onek onek bhalobasha aar shubhechha. Ami mon theke chai tomra khub aagey jao, nijeder moto kore grow koro, aar shob success pao ja tomra deserve koro. ❤️

See you again soon! 😘🥰💕".
